hint: The new script methods and "Make searchable PDF" of the file manager require AutoJs6 {{ required_host_version_name }} or later, and use in Node.js or Bun scripts requires Node.js Runtime 2.2.0 or Bun Runtime 0.23.0 or later; the new toolbox tools do not depend on AutoJs6
feature: pdf.forms and pdf.fillForm read form fields (text fields, check boxes, radio buttons, combo boxes, list boxes) and fill them in by field name, optionally flattened into ordinary page content; pdf.info adds the number of form fields
pdf.watermark and pdf.stamp add text or image watermarks, page numbers, headers and footers, with position, rotation, opacity, tiling and the pages they apply to

pdf.makeSearchable writes an invisible text layer into scanned pages with an OCR plugin, making PDF files whose text can be searched and copied; pdf.addTextLayer writes results a script recognized itself

pdf.compress re-encodes embedded images and compresses streams, can remove metadata, and offers the low / medium / high presets or custom resolution and quality; the result gives the size before and after
pdf.setInfo changes document properties such as the title, author, subject, keywords and creator, and pdf.setOutline rewrites or removes the outline in the shape pdf.outline returns

Every new method has an Async form and a method of the same name on PdfDocument, and works in Node.js, Bun and apps packaged by AutoJs6 too; results of methods that write files also carry warningCodes, so scripts can handle the hints by code

The toolbox adds 5 tools, "Add watermark to PDF" (with a one-page preview), "Add page numbers", "Compress PDF", "Fill in form" and "Document properties", 13 in all; watermark, page numbers and compression also accept custom values besides the presets

The result page of toolbox and file manager actions can write the run as a Rhino, Node.js or Bun script, with "Copy script", "Save as .js" and "Open in AutoJs6"; passwords are left as null in the script for you to fill in
The PDF menu of the AutoJs6 file manager adds "Compress PDF" and "Add watermark to PDF", which save the result next to the original file, and "Make searchable PDF" with an OCR plugin
improvement: The release history page now expands and collapses by version: a collapsed version shows its date and the number of entries per category, an expanded one names each category once; all versions can be expanded or collapsed at once, and the newest one opens expanded; the page is titled "Release history" (formerly "Version history") with the plugin name as the subtitle, and its entries in the "About" section of the settings and in the update dialog are renamed to match
The processing hints on the tool result page are now shown in the interface language instead of English only
Rewrote the instructions shown in the Plugin Center in five parts: getting started, main features, using it in scripts, requirements and FAQ

hint: The pdf module of AutoJs6 scripts and the file manager entries require AutoJs6 {{ required_host_version_name }} (internal build {{ required_host_version_code }}) or later; older AutoJs6 versions show the plugin as incompatible in the Plugin Center, and the toolbox and the viewer still work on their own
Use in Node.js or Bun scripts requires Node.js Runtime 2.2.0 or Bun Runtime 0.23.0 or later
feature: AutoJs6 scripts get the pdf module (also available as $pdf): read the information, text, outline and images of PDF files, search text, render pages to images, merge, split, extract, delete, reorder and rotate pages, generate PDF files from images, text or HTML, and encrypt and decrypt; every method has a blocking form and an Async form that can report progress and be cancelled
The ocr option of pdf.text recognizes scanned pages without a text layer with an installed OCR plugin (ML Kit OCR, Paddle OCR or Rapid OCR)
pdf.view opens a PDF in the plugin viewer; scripts receive page change and close events and can go to a page or close the viewer
Node.js and Bun scripts can use the pdf module too; its methods return Promises, and calls can be aborted with signal or timeoutMs

Apps packaged by AutoJs6 {{ required_host_version_name }} or later can use the pdf module too, with the needed permission added when packaging; documents and viewer sessions they open answer only the app that created them

Viewer: continuous scrolling, pinch zoom, thumbnails, outline, search highlights, go to page, password prompt and night mode; it opens from the launcher, and other apps can hand PDF files to it with "Open with" or sharing

AutoJs6 file manager: tapping a PDF opens it in the plugin viewer, and PDF files of up to 512 MiB inside archives open directly too; the menu offers merge, split, convert to images, extract text, encrypt and remove the password
Home screen: the tools, task progress, recent files and the all files access grant (only the toolbox needs it)

The recent files remember files opened with the system file picker (up to 20), which still open directly after a restart; a file that has been deleted or can no longer be accessed is reported and removed from the list

The toolbox offers 8 tools: merge, split (by page ranges or every n pages), PDF to images (resolution, format, pages), images to PDF (page size, orientation, margins), encrypt, remove the password, extract text (saved as TXT), and rotating, deleting and reordering pages with thumbnails; they share their processing with the file manager entries

Toolbox tasks run one after another in a foreground service and keep running after you leave the tool screen; the notification shows the progress and can cancel, and the results can be opened in the viewer or shared
A built-in file browser that can select several files and create folders; the system file picker is also available

Settings screen: default output folder (Documents/3-Paper PDF), default resolution of PDF to images, language, night mode, theme color, launcher icon, permission status, release history and update check
Update check: manually on the settings screen, or automatically when the home screen opens (at most once every 12 hours); release information comes from the official plugin index

Light and dark icons for the launcher and the Plugin Center; the launcher uses the adaptive automatic icon by default (it follows the system light or dark theme), and the adaptive light, adaptive dark and transparent background styles are built in, selectable on the settings screen
A single APK for every ABI: PDF processing contains no native library; the only native library comes from Jetpack Compose and is aligned to 16 KB memory pages
README, Plugin Center instructions and changelogs in 10 languages, generated from JSON sources
dependency: Attach PDFBox-Android 2.0.27.0 (text, outline, images, page operations and encryption)
Attach Jetpack Compose BOM 2026.09.00 (the plugin screens)
Attach Material Color Utilities (MaterialKolor) 4.1.1 (theme color of the plugin screens)
